description: Few-shot examples for the AI review: three Grill eval cases that do not overlap with the five QA Agent eval documents (one per language). Inputs are the documents' own requirements and the test cases the app generates for them (common.full_message). Answers contain only the requirement problems of each case's Grill gold (gold.issues; must_not_ask entries are left unreported); 'source' says which gold entry each item restates and is never sent to the model. The Grill gold has no test case labels, so the answers say nothing about the example test cases (the prompt says so).
selection: 08_en_irrelevant_traps: restraint (6 requirements that only look like input/boundary problems) + one input without error/result. 21_ru_duplicates_ai: a contradiction across units (200 мс vs 1 секунда) + a missing result. 29_uk_hallucinations_api: a time limit without a value + input without error/result + expired link. No example shows equal values in other units (the 1 МБ = 1024 КБ trap) or another scope (the admin session trap), so those traps measure generalization.
